name: reporter-desktop
description: Minimalist High-Precision Analytical CSV Reporter Desktop Application

scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/sample-data', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('sample-data/Jira(2).csv')) fs.copyFileSync('sample-data/Jira(2).csv', 'dist/sample-data/Jira(2).csv');"
